en.question: Where should a persistent instruction such as "You are a claims triage assistant. Never quote a settlement figure." be placed in a Messages API request?

options.text: In a message with role "system" inside the messages array.
options.note: There is no system role inside the messages array in this API; this returns a 400.

options.text: Prepended to the text of the first user message in the conversation.
options.note: It would function, but it mixes durable configuration into conversational content.

options.text: In the top-level system parameter of the request.
Repeated at the end of every user message so it stays in effect.
options.note: Wasteful repetition, and it still leaves the instruction inside user-controlled text.

en.explanation: The Messages API exposes system as its own top-level parameter. The messages array carries only user and assistant turns.
